question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be static, served at runtime, or documented as a TypeBox/JSON Schema generation path?
rationale: This choice defines external API compatibility, endpoint visibility, auth/scope semantics, and upgrade guarantees, so automation should not choose the permanent contract shape.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a release-attached or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Defer To Existing Protocol Schema
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/draft-07 JSON Schema pipeline is the intended supported client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The most directly related prior OpenAPI/schema work is vincentkoc's closed generated config OpenAPI PR, though steipete is also a strong Gateway protocol owner signal.
